I have tested positive for COVID-19. I am experiencing mild symptoms, but grateful to be vaccinated and boosted.

I will be following CDC guidelines and self isolating for the next few days, but looking forward to being back in the community soon.

The Inflation Reduction Act will lower prescription drug and energy costs, extend health coverage, act on climate, and create jobs.

It includes pieces of the Build Back Better Act and allows Democrats to keep our promise to improve the lives of families across the country.

Are you registered to vote?

Today is National Voter Registration Day and it's more important than ever to be registered to exercise your right to make your voice heard at the ballot box.

Don't wait. To register or check your registration status, visit: https://t.co/jQxPanBiEr https://t.co/Tn9xbxnpgu

This morning, I had the privilege of attending the White House briefing on Hunger, Nutrition, and Health. It's time to address the food insecurity affecting many different subgroups of Americans. https://t.co/RSS1UxxbwB

I sat down with @ASP yesterday to discuss how my bill with @RepBonamici would help eligible students access nutrition assistance programs. 

A student’s focus should be getting a quality education, not stressing over where their next meal will come from.

As Ranking Member of @VetAffairsDems, mental health awareness among our veterans is a top priority of mine. Today is PTSD Screening Day, and if you feel you are experiencing symptoms of PTSD, you are not alone. Use VA’s self screening tool to learn more: https://t.co/FY3qNvz0C1

PSA:📣This year, California returned to its pre-COVID Medicaid and CHIPS enrollment policies – meaning that if you use Medicaid, you need to confirm your coverage eligibility once a year. Visit https://t.co/OlPikDzaHH or call my district office at 951-222-0203 for help. https://t.co/7MKygjOEVC

@DeptVetAffairs officials are equipped to care for our most vulnerable beneficiaries while respecting veterans' constitutional rights, but my Republican colleagues want to open vets up to preventable tragedies. 
Watch coverage of yesterday's @VetAffairsDems legislative hearing: https://t.co/utHbOhEy1h

Destigmatizing HIV leads to more testing, treatment, and future eradication of HIV/AIDS. Congress must continue to prioritize access to PrEP and other proven treatments in stopping this disease. #NGMHAAD
Are you eligible for Medicare? If so, you have until December 7th to explore and compare different coverage plans. Visit https://t.co/KP1q0IrUv5 to find out more. https://t.co/DxXyZJaGa5
IVF is sometimes the only option for couples wanting to start a family. Alabama's ruling is extreme and will scare doctors and practitioners from helping patients. https://t.co/i1BVlYRnIz

Medicare Advantage preys on seniors and overcharges the federal government. I am proud to partner other progressive leaders to take on these bad actors while ensuring quality coverage for those who need it the most. https://t.co/ojUKgoCpkO

Right now, four out of five people who sign up for health insurance through the Affordable Care Act can find health care coverage for $10 a month or less.

We can’t let Republicans take away Americans’ healthcare.
To my dear colleague Raul Grijalva, I send healing wishes and Godspeed. You are in my thoughts and prayers. https://t.co/VYXIguleI7
Allowing Medicare to negotiate drug prices will lower costs for everyone. Drug companies and middlemen have put greed over patients, and @POTUS is doing looking to fix that. https://t.co/KBHkTaZYRR

A record 400,000 veterans have enrolled in VA healthcare this past year thanks to provisions found in my PACT Act. Every veteran deserves better health outcomes while paying less than non-VA care. https://t.co/gIQxiOiRzQ

LGBTQ+ students deserve to learn, play, and grow in school without the fear of bulling from their peers or politicians. On the annual Day of No Silence, I'm proud to introduce this resolution calling on us to prioritize the safety of LGBTQ+ students. https://t.co/IfSy42Y0yI

I arrived to Congress with @RepDonaldPayne in 2013. He served with distinction and dedication, even as he faced health challenges. He had a flair for bright suits and a cheerful presence. My deepest condolences to his family and his constituents. He’s earned a well-deserved rest.

The DOD has confirmed what we have known for years— burn pits cause health complications for veterans. I am proud that my PACT Act has provided over 5.4 million toxic exposure screenings to veterans to catch these symptoms and illnesses early. https://t.co/NkaxZuyZOl
A study published last year shows that gender affirming hormone therapy improved patients mental health and outlook on life. https://t.co/bxEbWzHHgI

A 2023 clinical trial showed that transgender individuals who had immediate access to hormone therapy saw significant decreases in depression than peers who had to wait three months for treatment. https://t.co/62a9tl4aS6

The "model minority" myth, language barriers, stigmas around HIV & being LGBTQI+, & fear of cultural shame often prevent AAPIs from seeking HIV treatment.

On #NAPIHAAD, I’m grateful to stand with @EqualityCaucus and @CAPAC to address HIV & AIDS in AAPI communities.
DACA recipients deserve access to healthcare just like everyone else. Healthcare is a fundamental human right, and I will always work to ensure that all people have access to health care coverage.

The Citizens United ruling broke our elections, allowing a handful of wealthy donors and corporations outsized influence. The time has come to increase transparency in our elections and implement effective campaign finance reforms for the health of our democracy.
For two years now, 988 has been a lifeline for millions of people. Mental health is a public emergency and I am glad Congress worked to deliver for those in crisis. https://t.co/GzoxNcqRkl
